## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** No functional issue found in the reviewed scope. The `realScreens` filter excludes both non-monitor screens described in #13163, keeps real outputs, and all three bar `Variants` (`BarPanel`, `DragGhostPanel`, `BarMoveGhostPanel`) use it, so bars and ghosts stay paired. One code-comment correction and an optional test note follow.

Screens the filter sees during a KVM switch-back, per Qt 6.11.2, Hyprland 0.56.2 and Quickshell 0.3.1 source:

| Screen | `name` | Size | Bar built |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qt placeholder (no outputs left) | `""` | 0x0 | no |
| Hyprland `FALLBACK` headless output | `FALLBACK` | 1920x1080 | no (name check needed, size alone would keep it) |
| Real monitor, e.g. `HDMI-A-1` | set before Qt adds the screen | real mode | yes |
| User-created headless output | `HEADLESS-N` | configured | yes, as before |

**Verified:** `Variants` keeps existing bars when `realScreens` recomputes. Quickshell reuses the same `ShellScreen` object per `QScreen`, and `Variants` only creates or destroys delegates for values added to or removed from the array (`src/core/variants.cpp`). A geometry change therefore does not rebuild bars. A sandboxed Quickshell probe with a JS-array model showed 0 delegate destructions across 5 re-evaluations.

**Verified:** The new `bar-test.sh` check passes on this head and fails on `quattro`, whose `Bar.qml` has three `model: Quickshell.screens` lines.

### Code comment overstates what is tracked

`Bar.qml:42-43` (and the PR description) says the name reads in the binding are tracked, "so a screen that arrives before it is named still gets its bar". Quickshell declares `ShellScreen.name` as `CONSTANT` (`src/core/qmlscreen.hpp`), and QML does not record dependencies on constant properties. For a nameless screen the loop also hits `continue` before reading `width`/`height`, so nothing about that screen is tracked.

**Impact:** None on behavior with Qt Wayland, which assigns a name before a screen appears in `Quickshell.screens`. The comment could lead a later change to rely on name-change tracking that does not exist.

**Suggested change:** Reword to something like: "The geometry reads are tracked, so a screen whose size arrives late still gets its bar. Qt names a screen before adding it."

**Optional test improvement:** The new checks match source text. A sandboxed mutation that points all three `Variants` at an unfiltered list, while leaving `realScreens` defined, still passes both checks, and an equivalent reordering of the guard condition fails the `perl` check. Moving the predicate into `BarModel.js` would allow a behavioral check in the existing Node block, using a nameless 0x0 screen, a `FALLBACK` 1920x1080 screen and a normal output.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of the pinned head plus Quickshell 0.3.1, Hyprland 0.56.2 and Qt 6.11.2 (qtbase Wayland QPA, qtdeclarative) source. Sandboxed runs covered the new checks on head and base, the mutation cases above, and a `Variants` reuse probe using stand-in objects under the offscreen platform (no real screens). The full `bar-test.sh` was not run (Node unavailable in the sandbox; only the checks before the first Node step ran). No KVM, hardware or live compositor reproduction; the reconnect timings in the PR description were not reproduced.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
